title: Glowing bell
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE566' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFD700' stop-opacity='0.15'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bellBody' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF3A0'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E6A800'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='rimGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='0%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE566'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#CC8800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='handleGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='0%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#B8860B'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M42 22 Q50 8 58 22' fill='none' stroke='url(#handleGrad)' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bell body -->
  <path d='M30 72 Q30 40 50 34 Q70 40 70 72 Z' fill='url(#bellBody)'/>

  <!-- bell rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='7' fill='url(#rimGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='18' ry='5' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- clapper -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='6' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='78.5' r='2' fill='#FFF3A0' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- shine on body -->
  <path d='M38 48 Q40 38 48 37' fill='none' stroke='#FFF9D6' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <g stroke='#FFF9D6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'>
    <line x1='24' y1='42' x2='20' y2='42'/>
    <line x1='22' y1='44' x2='22' y2='48'/>
    <line x1='76' y1='38' x2='80' y2='38'/>
    <line x1='78' y1='36' x2='78' y2='32'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='88' x2='72' y2='88'/>
    <line x1='28' y1='90' x2='24' y2='90'/>
  </g>
</svg>
